title: 小鳄鱼爱洗澡
subtitle: WHERE'S MY WATER?
description: 挖开泥土，把清水引进小鳄鱼的浴缸。规划一条好路线，别忘了沿途的小鸭子。
coverAlt: 小鳄鱼爱洗澡关卡：让水穿过泥土，流进浴缸

en.title: Where’s My Water?
en.subtitle: WHERE’S MY WATER?
en.description: Dig through the dirt and guide clean water into Swampy’s bathtub. Plan a clever route and collect the ducks along the way.
en.coverAlt: Where’s My Water? level with water, dirt, ducks, and Swampy in his bathtub

title: 割绳子
subtitle: CUT THE ROPE
description: 看准时机，轻轻一剪。收集星星，让糖果落进 Om Nom 的嘴里，开启一场甜蜜冒险。
coverAlt: 割绳子关卡：悬挂的糖果、三颗星星和等待投喂的 Om Nom

en.title: Cut the Rope
en.subtitle: CUT THE ROPE
en.description: Time your cuts, collect the stars, and feed the candy to Om Nom. A sweet little adventure is waiting.
en.coverAlt: Cut the Rope level with hanging candy, three stars, and Om Nom waiting below

title: 窄道停车
subtitle: NARROW PARKING
description: 慢慢转向，稳稳停车。在狭窄路段控制好速度，挑战你的驾驶与停车技巧。
coverAlt: 窄道停车游戏画面：在狭窄道路中驾驶并寻找停车位置

en.title: Narrow Parking
en.subtitle: NARROW PARKING
en.description: Find your line, keep a steady speed, and ease into tight parking spots. A little patience goes a long way.
en.coverAlt: Narrow Parking gameplay with a car navigating narrow roads and parking spaces

title: 化妆解压
subtitle: 轻松护理，随心上妆
description: 跟随画面提示，清洁护理、挑选妆容。慢慢完成每一个小步骤，享受轻松的化妆时光。
coverAlt: 化妆解压游戏封面：人物面部护理与化妆

title: 吃苹果的蛇
subtitle: SNAKE TO EAT
description: 吃苹果、长身体，绕过障碍与悬崖。动动脑筋，让灵活的小蛇抵达出口。
coverAlt: 吃苹果的蛇：小蛇、苹果与方块平台

en.title: Snake to Eat
en.subtitle: SNAKE TO EAT
en.description: Eat apples, grow longer, and work your way around tricky obstacles. Help a hungry snake reach the exit.
en.coverAlt: Snake to Eat with a snake, apples, and block platforms
